reason: The cited evidence mentions CrAl as a metallic coating strategy (E1) but provides no data on Al2O3 formation at the Cr/Zr interface, its role as a diffusion barrier, or its effect on interdiffusion. The key mechanistic premises are therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
